Hi Larkspur team,

I'm really excited about our company launch event and I think it would be amazing to have your Countess there. We'd love to collect it from the garage on Wednesday 5 May 2027 at 11:30 and then return it on 6th May 2027 at 09:00. As per your website, the total cost comes out to be 576.00 euros. I've attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Cheers,
Silas Sedgewick-Rowe
